thermodynamic_interpretation.physical_justification: Under pre-monsoon solar irradiance (K_down ~ 870 W/m2) and aerodynamic convective resistance (r_a ~ 20-40 s/m), dry low-albedo impervious surfaces (alpha ~ 0.12-0.18) must elevate 8C to 16C above ambient 2m air to dissipate sensible heat into the boundary layer. The satellite LST skin temperature is fully consistent with micrometeorological surface energy balance.
